column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- pascal-lisp: the entries of this package out of the published denominator, one row per entry: name<TAB>CLASS<TAB>the evidence (lib_excluded.sh).
# NEEDS_C_LIBRARY (CTO-525, skill pascal section 1): a C library SCRIP has no Pascal-source stand-in for. The collection is read in place under the GPL, so its units are never rewritten.

column3: lispi uses unit Lisp, which uses the collection's unit BoehmGC: boehmgc.pas line 12 binds GCMalloc to libgc's GC_malloc (cdecl; external 'libgc'), and its initialization (line 126) installs a TMemoryManager of routines over it by SetMemoryManager, so every heap block of the interpreter is a libgc block reached by raw pointer arithmetic (Dec(P, SizeOf(PtrInt)), PPtrInt(P)^); SCRIP has no external directive and no memory-manager hook, and a stand-in cannot exist under its (base cell, index) pointers (R5). Measured by junior_06, senior_01 and officer_04 on row pascal-lisp-red-lispi 2026-11-12; the grammar defect found on the way (GetP(1).NextChar;) landed in SCRIP@3d9f6b862; the unit IOStream lispi also names waits on the untyped-formals design (skill pascal section 10).
